```yaml
name: Verify DCO Sign-off

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  verify_dco:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'master'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Verify DCO sign-off
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PR_NUMBER=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          BASE_SHA=${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          echo "Checking commits in PR #$PR_NUMBER from $BASE_SHA to $HEAD_SHA"

          # Get list of commits in PR excluding merge commits
          COMMITS=$(git rev-list $BASE_SHA..$HEAD_SHA)
          MISSING=()
          for COMMIT in $COMMITS; do
            # Skip merge commits
            if git rev-parse --verify $COMMIT^2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Skipping merge commit $COMMIT"
              continue
            fi
            MESSAGE=$(git show -s --format=%B $COMMIT)
            if ! echo "$MESSAGE" | grep -q 'Signed-off-by:'; then
              echo "Commit $COMMIT is missing Signed-off-by"
              MISSING+=("$COMMIT")
            else
              echo "Commit $COMMIT has Signed-off-by"
            fi
          done

          if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::The following commits are missing DCO sign-off:"
            for C in "${MISSING[@]}"; do
              echo "::error::  $C"
            done
            echo "::error::Please add a Signed-off-by line to each commit message."
            echo "::error::You can amend the commits with 'git commit --amend -s' or rebase with 'git rebase -i --exec \"git commit --amend -s\"'."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "All commits have DCO sign-off."
          fi
```
